mapper.select: SELECT B.BNO,B.BNAME,B.BIMG,MB.MBNO,MB.OLNO,MB.MBSTART,MB.MBEND,MB.MBSTATUS, MB.MBLATEDATE,MB.MBLATEFEE,TRUNC(MB.MBEND) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DAYSLEFT FROM MEMBER_BOOKS MB LEFT JOIN BOOK B ON MB.BNO = B.BNO WHERE MB.MNO = #{mno} AND MB.MBSTATUS IN ('대여중','연체') ORDER BY MB.OLNO DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_BOOKS WHERE MNO=#{mno} AND ( MBSTATUS='연체' OR (MBSTATUS='대여중' AND MBEND < TRUNC(SYSDATE)) )
SELECT NVL(SUM((TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(MBEND))*2500),0) FROM MEMBER_BOOKS WHERE MNO=#{mno} AND ( MBSTATUS='연체' OR (MBSTATUS ='대여중' AND MBEND < TRUNC(SYSDATE)) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_BOOKS WHERE MNO = #{mno} AND (MBRETURN IS NULL OR MBSTATUS = '대여중')
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_BOOKS SET MBEND = MBEND + #{extendDays}, MBEXTENSION = MBEXTENSION + 1 WHERE MBNO=#{mbno}
UPDATE MEMBER_BOOKS SET MBSTATUS='연체', MBLATEDATE=TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(MBEND), MBLATEFEE=(TRUNC(SYSDATE)-TRUNC(MBEND))*2500 WHERE MNO=#{mno} AND MBSTATUS IN ('대여중','연체') AND MBEND < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
